headline: Midwestern State go furthest of the division's unbeaten sides
dek: Lees-McRae lost at home to Young Harris on the night Midwestern State won at Sul Ross State. Midwestern State have now played seventeen matches without defeat, winning thirteen and drawing four, and no other unbeaten side in the division has played as many.
displaced_by: results night: Lees-McRae's defeat leaves Midwestern State as the unbeaten side with the most matches played in the division
